entities.summary: Akira Akatsuki  is a Japanese manga artist. His most notable work was as the illustrator for Nisio Isin's manga series Medaka Box, which ran in Weekly Shōnen Jump from 2009 to 2013. Another one of his works, Luger Code 1951, was adapted into a net anime by Studio Deen in 2016.
